cases.name: fresh-explicit-session-dir
cases.result: creates one v3 JSONL file and emits a session header

cases.name: resume-by-full-path
cases.result: reuses the same id, timestamp, cwd, and file; appends new entries

cases.name: resume-by-partial-id
cases.result: observed success with a unique id prefix; same session id and file were reused

cases.name: fork-by-full-path
cases.result: creates a new id and file with parentSession pointing at the source file

cases.name: resume-from-different-cwd
cases.result: uses the stored session cwd; resumed tool execution resolved relative to the stored cwd

cases.name: missing-explicit-path
cases.result: creates a fresh session at the requested path

cases.name: missing-id-in-session-dir
cases.result: fails before agent start with exit status 1 and no session

cases.name: malformed-interior-line
cases.result: ignored and session remains resumable; adapter must tolerate malformed lines

cases.name: unknown-session-version
cases.result: accepted as forward-compatible and preserved in the emitted header

cases.name: syntactically-invalid-header
cases.result: not yet tested; future adapter must classify as malformed rather than infer identity from filename

sanitization: UUIDs, entry ids, timestamps, paths, and private text are replaced with placeholders while equality and parent relationships are preserved.
